_comment: Context tiers by rate vendor and model, merged into rate-cards.json by code that prices them (src/server/rate-cards-file.ts). A model may have a tier or not; `long_context` rates apply to a request whose prompt input, cache reads and writes included, is strictly above `above_input_tokens`. Fields of a rate-cards.json entry for the same model win; `"long_context": null` there removes the tier.

claude-haiku-5-5.note: Official price (platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/haiku-5-5/overview), verified 2026-10-13: above 100,000 prompt tokens every category costs 5x.
